meta.name: arbor
meta.description: Autonomously improve a real artifact (code, training recipe, agent harness, data pipeline, prompt) against an objective and an evaluator, using Hypothesis Tree Refinement (HTR) from the Arbor paper. Use this whenever someone wants to iteratively optimize something over many experiments without overfitting — e.g. "get my model's eval score up", "improve this agent/harness", "tune this pipeline", "beat the baseline on this benchmark", "run a search over approaches and keep the best", "do an MLE-bench / Kaggle-style optimization", or any long-horizon "make this artifact better and don't just memorize the dev set" task. Trigger it even when the user doesn't say "Arbor" or "hypothesis tree" but describes repeated experiment-and-evaluate loops, branching exploration of competing ideas, or worries about a dev/test gap. Runs Claude itself as the coordinator with subagent executors in isolated git worktrees; for the standalone `arbor` CLI tool see references/arbor-upstream.md.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用自动实验把模型或流程的评分逐步顶高
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常为模型或流程的分数头疼,想用自动实验挑出更稳妥的方案
copy.tagline_en: Run experiments to push model or pipeline scores steadily higher
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need automatic experiments to improve a model or pipeline and avoid overfitting.

howto.what: Claude 会作为协调者，围绕可测量目标反复改进你给的产物（如代码、训练配方、提示词）：用假设树记录每轮实验，派子代理在隔离 git worktree 中各测一个假设，只有通过留存测试评估器的改动才被采用，最后给你可运行的产物与报告。
howto.when: 当你要求提升某个具体产物（如模型 eval 分数、agent 通过率、提示词），且能反复打分时触发；即使你没提 Arbor 或“假设树”，只要在描述反复实验评测或担心过拟合，也会触发。

say.text: 帮我把这个仓库的 eval 分数提上去
say.note: Claude 会先确认目标、dev 与留存测试评估命令

say.text: 给我的 agent harness 做长期优化，别过拟合 dev
say.note: 多轮跑子代理，只有通过测试门的改动才合并

say.text: 把这条数据合成 pipeline 调到下游模型表现更好
say.note: 用 dev 搜索，测试评估器决定是否合并

howto.what_en: Claude runs a loop that improves a real artifact toward a measurable goal. It logs experiments in a hypothesis tree, sends subagents to test one hypothesis each in git worktrees, and merges only changes passing a held-out test evaluator.
howto.when_en: When you want to iteratively improve an artifact (eval score, agent harness, prompt) that you can score repeatedly — even if you never say “Arbor” — or describe repeated experiment/evaluate loops.

say_en.note: Claude first confirms the objective, dev and held-out test evaluators

say_en.text: Long-run optimize my agent harness without overfitting dev
say_en.note: Runs cycles with subagents; only test-gate passes get merged

say_en.text: Tune this data pipeline for better downstream model behavior
say_en.note: Searches on dev, uses the test evaluator to decide merges
